const _mx_activeTiers_ = _mx_tierConfig_[_mx_N_] || _mx_tierConfig_[5];

const _mx_genMutex_ = (_idx_) => {
  let _t1_ = [], _t2_ = [], _t3_ = [], _t4_ = [], _t5_ = [];
  
  _mx_features_.forEach((_f_, _i_) => {
    if (_idx_ === _i_) return;
    
    // Tier 1
    if (_f_.hairColor) _t1_.push(_f_.hairColor);
    if (_f_.hairColorSub) _t1_.push(_f_.hairColorSub);
    if (_f_.eyeColor) _t1_.push(_f_.eyeColor);
    if (_f_.outfitColor) _t1_.push(_f_.outfitColor);
    
    // Tier 2
    if (_f_.faceShape) _t2_.push(_f_.faceShape);
    if (_f_.hairStyle) _t2_.push(_f_.hairStyle);
    if (_f_.bodyType) _t2_.push(_f_.bodyType);
    if (_f_.chestSize) _t2_.push(_f_.chestSize);
    
    // Tier 3
    if (_f_.skinTone) _t3_.push(_f_.skinTone);
    if (_f_.eyeShape) _t3_.push(_f_.eyeShape);
    
    // Tier 4
    if (_f_.animalEars) _t4_.push(_f_.animalEars);
    if (_f_.tail) _t4_.push(_f_.tail);
    if (_f_.wings) _t4_.push(_f_.wings);
    if (_f_.horns) _t4_.push(_f_.horns);
    
    // Tier 5
    if (_f_.glasses) _t5_.push(_f_.glasses);
    if (_f_.choker) _t5_.push(_f_.choker);
    if (_f_.hairAcc) _t5_.push(_f_.hairAcc);
  });
  
  const _fmt_ = (_arr_, _w_) => _arr_.length ? _arr_.map(_t_ => _w_ + '::' + _t_ + '::').join(', ') : '';
  
  return {
    tier1: _mx_activeTiers_.includes('tier1') ? _fmt_([..._t1_], '1.5') : '',
    tier2: _mx_activeTiers_.includes('tier2') ? _fmt_([..._t2_], '1.3') : '',
    tier3: _mx_activeTiers_.includes('tier3') ? _fmt_([..._t3_], '1.2') : '',
    tier4: _mx_activeTiers_.includes('tier4') ? _fmt_([..._t4_], '1.3') : '',
    tier5: _mx_activeTiers_.includes('tier5') ? _fmt_([..._t5_], '1.2') : ''
  };
};

const _mx_userDNA_ = _mx_userKey_ ? _mx_dna_[_mx_userKey_] : null;

  const _charName_ = _id_.中文名 || _id_.英文名 || _name_;
  const _isMale_ = _bio_.性别 === 'male';

  if (_outfitStatus_ !== 'Intact') {

    if (_outfitStatus_ === 'Damaged') {
      _items_.push('⚠️ 破损: [torn clothes], [ripped clothing], [disheveled]');

    }

  }

  if (_tempItems_.length > 0) {
    _sections_.push({ title: '🌡️ 身体状态', items: _tempItems_ });
  }
  
  // 妆容状态
  let _makeupItems_ = [];
  if (_eyes_.眼妆) _makeupItems_.push('👁️ 眼妆: ' + _eyes_.眼妆);
  if (_mouth_.唇妆) _makeupItems_.push('💋 唇妆: ' + _mouth_.唇妆);
  if (_makeupItems_.length > 0) {
    _sections_.push({ title: '💄 当前妆容', items: _makeupItems_ });
  }
  
  // 可变配饰
  let _accItems_ = [];
  if (_hair_.发饰) _accItems_.push('🎀 发饰: ' + _hair_.发饰);

  if (_u_hair_.发色主) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_hair_.发色主);
  if (_u_hair_.发长) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_hair_.发长);
  if (_u_hair_.发型) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_hair_.发型);
  if (_u_hair_.刘海) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_hair_.刘海);
  if (_u_isMale_) {
    if (_u_mchest_.肌肉度) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_mchest_.肌肉度);
  } else {
    if (_u_chest_.尺寸) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_chest_.尺寸);
    if (_u_chest_.形状) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_chest_.形状);
  }
  if (_u_hips_.尺寸) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_hips_.尺寸);
  if (_u_thighs_.粗细) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_thighs_.粗细);
  
  // 配饰
  Object.values(_u_acc_).forEach(_v_ => _v_ && _u_dnaArr_.push(_v_));
  
  // 非人特征
  if (_u_nh_.ears.启用 && _u_nh_.ears.类型) {
    _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_nh_.ears.类型);
    if (_u_nh_.ears.颜色) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_nh_.ears.颜色);
  }
  if (_u_nh_.tail.启用 && _u_nh_.tail.类型) {
    _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_nh_.tail.类型);
    if (_u_nh_.tail.蓬松度) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_nh_.tail.蓬松度);
  }
  if (_u_nh_.wings.启用 && _u_nh_.wings.类型) {
    _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_nh_.wings.类型);
    if (_u_nh_.wings.颜色) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_nh_.wings.颜色);
  }
  if (_u_nh_.horns.启用 && _u_nh_.horns.类型) {
    _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_nh_.horns.类型);
    if (_u_nh_.horns.颜色) _u_dnaArr_.push(_u_nh_.horns.颜色);
  }
  
  const _u_dnaStr_ = _u_dnaArr_.filter(_x_ => _x_).join(', ');
  
  // 表情
  let _u_exprArr_ = [];
  if (_u_expr_.眼神) _u_exprArr_.push(_u_expr_.眼神);
  if (_u_expr_.嘴部) _u_exprArr_.push(_u_expr_.嘴部);
  if (_u_expr_.整体) _u_exprArr_.push(_u_expr_.整体);
  const _u_exprStr_ = _u_exprArr_.filter(_x_ => _x_).join(', ');
  
  // UC
  let _u_ucArr_ = [];
  Object.values(_u_uc_).forEach(_v_ => _v_ && _u_ucArr_.push(_v_));
  const _u_ucStr_ = _u_ucArr_.filter(_x_ => _x_).join(', ');
